description: A SIGN clause on a report group description entry that is a GROUP, i.e. has subordinate entries (kb/Work PB3683). ANSI X3.23-1985 admitted the clause only on an elementary report entry; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 123 QUOTES the change: 'the SIGN clause may be specified at the group level' in a report description entry. The 2023 text of 13.18.52.3 SR1 admits 'an alphanumeric group item, national group item, or strongly-typed group item', which a report group entry with subordinates is, and 13.15.3 does not restrict it. Gated in ONE place, DataBinder.ScreenReportSignClauses (once per written entry).
display: a SIGN clause on a report group description entry that is a group
vcr: VCR row 7.40 (85->2002: a report group entry's SIGN clause may be specified at the group level)
